notes:
Flights (verified in the model). Tread clusters of SOURCE_OTHER (scripts/compute_ramps.py, ramps.json): W1 15 treads at 35°, W2 10 at 25°, E1 13 at 22°, E2 12 at 25°, E3 11 at 25°. The model's E3 overshoots the floor by two risers (2.53 / 2.62 m) and leaves a 0.15 m gap to the slab; its inner balustrade runs over the head of E2 (1.3 m clear). Both are handled on the building page.

Photos. 108, 109, 111, 114 (Founder Space stair); 198, 199, 201–204 (Reception stair).

Built as new objects. Dark brown rubber treads and grey risers on the model flights (shader); steel balustrades with wood handrails along every open side; dark grey fascia panels on the east stair's stringers; a white wall with the yellow and black “pacman” mural; a plant on the landing in a teal ringed pot; a roll-up banner at the foot; a dark wood panelled wall beside W1; a fire-exit sign. The Cafeteria's wall art and cluster pendant over the Reception stair are reused.

Differences from the photos. (1) The model's Reception stair well is about 1 m wide; the real well is much larger and open over the lower flight. (2) The ground floor seen from the Founder Space stair is a light stand-in for Founder Space 1, not that room's finished scene.
